build_discrete_valued_head: build a DiscreteValuedHead module that outputs a parameterized discrete valued distribution with configurable vmin vmax and num_atoms
build_multivariate_normal_diag_head: build a MultivariateNormalDiagHead module that produces a multivariate normal distribution with configurable dimensions and scale
build_gaussian_mixture_head: build a GaussianMixture module that outputs a mixture of Gaussians distribution with configurable components and dimensions
build_univariate_gaussian_mixture_head: build a UnivariateGaussianMixture head that outputs independent 1d GMM models for each output dimension
build_approximate_mode_module: build an ApproximateMode module that overrides the mode function for transformed distributions with non-constant Jacobians
